embeddings.title: Kukonzekera zikalata zanu
embeddings.description: Kulozera mafayilo omwe ali nawo kuti athe kufufuzidwa ndikutchulidwa. Izi zitha kutenga nthawi kuti zilembedwe zazikulu.

creation.musicLyricsGuide: Fotokozani kalembedwe ndi mawu pazofunsa zanu. Ikani mawu pansi pa ma tag pansipa. Zimitsani {{instrumental}} pamawu.
creation.setupStorage: Mafayilo onse: {{download}}. Sungani: {{reserve}}. Malo owonjezera akufunika: {{required}}. Zaulere pamagalimoto osankhidwa: {{free}}.
creation.setupSpaceMissing: Akusowa {{missing}}. Masulani malo kapena sankhani galimoto ina yokhala ndi malo okwanira.
creation.setupTextNote: Njira yogwiritsira ntchito malemba pokha pokambirana, kulemba, zida ndi mayankho okonzedwa bwino. Tsitsani: pafupifupi {{size}}. Imafunika kukumbukira kwambiri kuposa {{defaultModel}} ndipo sipanga zithunzi kapena zomvera zokha. Mayankho oyankhulidwa amagwiritsa ntchito mawu adongosolo. Sankhani kuti mugwiritse ntchito mawu mukakhala ndi kukumbukira kokwanira. Onani mayankho owona ndi magwero.
creation.setupImageNote: FLUX.2 Klein 4B Q4_K_M amapanga zithunzi; Qwen3 amamasulira mawuwa ndipo VAE imapanga chithunzi chomaliza. Sinthani mawonekedwe, kusintha, mbewu, masitepe ndi kukwera. Malingaliro oyambilira: 21:9, masitepe anayi ndi mbewu mwachisawawa.
creation.setupMusicNote: ACE-Step 1.5 Turbo imapanga nyimbo za zida kapena nyimbo. Wokonza mapulani amamanga dongosolo; the 2B Q4_K_M jenereta imaphatikizidwira, chosindikiza mawu chimakhala ndi tanthauzo ndipo VAE imatsitsa mawu omvera a 48 kHz. Sinthani nthawi, mtundu wamawu, tempo, mawu, chilankhulo, masitepe ndi mbewu. Alangizidwa: masekondi 30, masitepe asanu ndi atatu, WAV 24-bit ndi mbewu mwachisawawa.
creation.setupVideoNote: Wan2.1 T2V 1.3B Q4_K_M imapanga makanema ofotokozera. Alangizidwa: masekondi asanu, 21:9 ndi 16 FPS. Sinthani nthawi, kuchuluka kwa chimango, kukonza, masitepe ndi mbewu. Zolinga zazitali zimasonkhanitsa tatifupi zazifupi; mabala owoneka atheka. · MP4: Python + imageio-ffmpeg.
creation.setupAllNote: Koperani ndikusintha mitundu yovomerezeka: LFM3-Omni + mmproj za text, Qwen3-Embedding Q8_0 pobweza zinenero zambiri (CPU mwachisawawa), FLUX.2 Klein 4B ndi zigawo zake kuti apange zithunzi, Real-ESRGAN ×2/×4, ACE-Step nyimbo (Instrumental on by default), ndi Wan2.1 za kanema. Chongani wapamwamba kukula, litayamba danga ndi kanema prerequisites pansipa. Olekanitsa kutsitsa ndi Kusakatula kumakhalabe kupezeka.
creation.videoDurationNote: Makanema aatali amasonkhanitsidwa kuchokera kumakanema achidule. Kudula kumatha kuwoneka ndipo kupanga kumatha kutenga nthawi yayitali.
creation.configure: Sankhani mtundu wa mtambo wokhala ndi kiyi ya API, kapena sinthani injini yomwe mwasankha ndi mafayilo ake ofunikira pazokonda za Creation.
creation.localNote: Zithunzi zam'deralo zimagwiritsa ntchito chikwatu chathunthu cha Diffusers, magawo osiyana a GGUF/Safetensors okhala ndi stable-diffusion.cpp, kapena zolemera za NVFP4 CUDA zothandizidwa ndi Python. Mavidiyo amagwiritsa ntchito Diffusers. Zosankha za CPU/GPU ndizosiyana pa encoder ndi jenereta ya zithunzi mumainjini otengera zigawo.
creation.autosave: Zithunzi ndi makanema omwe adamalizidwa amasungidwa m'mafoda osiyana a Novera mkati mwa zikwatu zanu za Zithunzi ndi Makanema, ndi zokonda zake.
creation.autoNote: Auto imazindikira pempho lopanga zithunzi kapena makanema achi French ndi Chingerezi. Mukhoza kusankha linanena bungwe mtundu nokha.
creation.source: Cholengedwa chomwe chilipo chidzagwiritsidwa ntchito ngati chithunzi cholowetsa.
creation.variantPrompt: Pangani mtundu watsopano wa chithunzichi, ndikusunga mutu wake waukulu.
creation.desktopOnly: Kupanga zithunzi ndi makanema ndikusunga zokha kumapezeka pakompyuta.
creation.inputUnsupported: Gwiritsani ntchito chithunzi chimodzi chothandizidwa ndi mtundu womwe mwasankha. Makanema ndi zithunzi zingapo sizikugwira ntchito pano.
creation.animatePrompt: Onetsani chithunzichi ndikusunga mutu wake waukulu.
creation.filterNote: Zithunzi ndi Kanema zosefera zomwe zatulutsidwa. Mitundu ya Multimodal imatha kumvetsetsa mitundu ingapo yolowera; izi sizitanthauza kuti nthawi zonse amatha kupanga zithunzi kapena makanema.
creation.generationOnly: Mtunduwu umapanga media. Sankhani izo mu Image kapena Video gulu.
creation.cloudNote: Cloud generation imatumiza chithunzi chanu chachangu komanso cholowetsa kwa omwe mwasankha ndipo atha kukulipirani. Kuyimitsa kwanuko sikungaletse kulipira kwakutali.
creation.cloudDefaults: Cloud imagwiritsa ntchito zokhazikitsira mwapadera. Zosintha zam'deralo zimagwira ntchito pa injini yosankha yapafupi.
creation.cloudTimeout: Ntchito yamtambo sinathe mkati mwa malire a nthawi. Yang'anani momwe ilili ndi wothandizirayo musanayambe mbadwo wina wolipidwa.
creation.adobeCredentials: Adobe Firefly ikufunika chizindikiritso cha kasitomala ndi x-api-key pazikhazikiko za operekera.
creation.catalogNote: Wothandizira uyu amagwiritsa ntchito mndandanda wazosasinthika. Kuyitsitsimutsa sikutsimikizira kiyi kapena mwayi wofikira ku akaunti yanu. Palibe m'badwo wolipidwa womwe umagwiritsidwa ntchito kuyesa zidziwitso.
creation.ggufImageModel: Mtundu wamitundu (GGUF kapena wogwirizana ndi Safetensors)
creation.ggufTextEncoder: Chojambulira mawu (GGUF kapena chogwirizana ndi Safetensors})
creation.ggufNote: Sankhani mtundu wophatikiza, encoder yamawu ndi VAE padera. Pa FLUX.2 Klein 4B, gwiritsani ntchito encoder ya Qwen3-4B yogwirizana, kuphatikiza mitundu yake ya GGUF. Mafayilo othandizidwa a NVFP4 amakonzedwa kamodzi ndi Python ndi PyTorch mu kachesi yayikulu yofananira; zoyamba sizisintha. Izi zimafuna malo owonjezera a disk ndi RAM. Pa Windows, Novera imaphatikizapo ndikuwongolera injini yokha. Auto imagwiritsa ntchito zida zomwe zilipo; CUDA ikufunika kumanga CUDA. Distilled Klein nthawi zambiri amagwiritsa ntchito masitepe 4 ndi CFG 1. Palibe zolemera zomwe zimatsitsidwa.
creation.ggufWrongModel: GGUF ili ndi chosindikiza mawu. Sankhani m'gawo la encoder ndikusankha mtundu wosiyana wosiyana m'gawo lazithunzi.
creation.nativeNote: Native NVFP4 CUDA: FLUX.2 Klein 4B Comfy weights, Qwen3-4B GGUF encoder ndi FLUX.2 Safetensors VAE. Pamafunika Blackwell (RTX 50 mndandanda kapena yogwirizana), Python, CUDA PyTorch ndi kusankha NVFP4 kudalira. Zolemba ndi zithunzi zokha. Zida zosagwiritsidwa ntchito zimalephera momveka bwino; sankhani stable-diffusion.cpp kuti mugwirizane. Palibe BF16 kufalikira posungira. Novera imawerenga Qwen mwachindunji kuchokera mu fayilo ya GGUF.
creation.deviceNote: Magawo awa ali ndi zosankha zodziyimira pawokha. Auto imagwiritsa ntchito zida zomwe zilipo; NVFP4 nthawi zonse imafunika GPU yogwirizana kuti igwirizane ndipo amagwiritsa ntchito GPU kukopera mawu kokwanira VRAM ndi yaulere. Qwen pa CPU ikhoza kusunga VRAM koma ndikuyika mochedwa. Qwen pa GPU amagwiritsa ntchito kutsitsa kosanjikiza. Mu stable-diffusion.cpp, Auto imatsatira injini yosankhidwa; kukakamiza CUDA kumafuna CUDA kumanga.
creation.totalTimeHint: Nthawi yonse ikuphatikiza kutsitsa, kuyika mawu, kupanga, kudikirira mtambo uliwonse, kutsitsa ndi kusunga. M'badwo wokha umawonetsedwa padera pamene injini ikunena.
creation.recommendedSetupNote: GPU generation, Qwen3-4B encoding pa CPU, 4 masitepe, CFG 1. Kuyesedwa pa Windows ndi Vulkan; liwiro ndi ngakhale zimadalira zida zanu.
creation.seedNote: Zithunzi zakomweko zokha. Fananizani ndi chitsanzo chomwecho ndi zoikamo.
creation.imageResolutionMax: Kusintha kwakukulu mu Novera: 2048 × 2048 px. Kukumbukira kokwanira kumafunika.
creation.upscaleNote: Pambuyo pa m'badwo. Imafunika Python/PyTorch. Zolemba malire linanena bungwe: × 2 4096 × 4096, × 4 8192 × 8192.
creation.upscaleMissing: Konzekerani ndi kutsimikizira zigawo zofunikira za m'dera lanu mu Novera · Zosintha.
creation.sizeAutoNote: Kusintha chiyerekezo kumatengera momwe ziliri pano. Miyezo imagwiritsa ntchito kuchulukitsa kwa 16, mpaka 2048 px.
creation.setupTextNvfp4Note: Mwasankha NVFP4 zolemera zomwe zazindikirika NVIDIA Blackwell GPU kapena zatsopano ndi osachepera 4.5 GiB ya VRAM. Kuti mugwiritse ntchito zolemera izi mu Novera, nkhokwe yachitsanzo yonse iyenera kaye kusinthidwa kukhala yogwirizana ndi NVFP4 GGUF ndi kutsimikiziridwa. Kutembenukaku sikunatsimikizidwebe pamalopa. Fayilo ya Safetensors yolumikizidwayo siyingakwezedwe mwachindunji ndi injini yomangidwira. Q8_0 akadali malingaliro okonzeka kugwiritsidwa ntchito. Zosowa zokumbukira zimadaliranso kutalika kwa nkhani.
creation.setupOmniNote: Zosintha pakompyuta ndi pa foni yam'manja. Mtundu wophatikizika wamawu, zithunzi ndi mawu, pogwiritsa ntchito fayilo yofunikira ya {{projector}}. Tsitsani: pafupifupi {{size}} pamafayilo onse awiri. Sankhani kuti mukhazikitse ma multimodal opepuka. Mawonekedwe a mawu amadalira nsanja ndi injini. Nkhani yayitali imagwiritsa ntchito kukumbukira kwambiri.

memory.title: Kukumbukira kwachitsanzo kwanuko
memory.autoNote: Imalowetsamo zotsatsira pakufunika ndikutulutsa mitundu yosagwiritsidwa ntchito ikamaliza kugwira ntchito.
memory.manualNote: Mawu, chithunzi ndi vidiyo zitha kuyendera limodzi pamakambirano osiyana ngati RAM/VRAM alola. Zitsanzo zitha kutha kukumbukira.
memory.preserve: Mafayilo ndi zokambirana zimasungidwa; zitsanzo zimatsegulanso zikafunika. Zosintha zimagwiranso ntchito pazofunsira zatsopano.
memory.failed: Kukhathamiritsa kukumbukira kwalephera. Yeseraninso kapena sankhani Buku Lothandizira.

sharing.imageHint: Kusintha kwa zithunzi kumagwiritsa ntchito chimango chokhazikika. SVG amaika chithunzi cha raster; ICO ili ndi 256 px.
sharing.videoHint: Gwiritsani ntchito HTML kapena ZIP kuti musunge mavidiyo ndi mafayilo oyamba.
sharing.fallback: Kugawana pamakina sikukupezeka pano pamawonekedwe awa. Sungani kapena sindikizani fayilo.
sharing.tooLarge: Zotumiza kunja ndizazikulu kwambiri. Sankhani zinthu zochepa kapena gawani zowonera zoyambira.
sharing.failed: Simungathe kumaliza kutumiza kapena kugawana. Chongani owona ndi kuyesa mtundu wina.
sharing.localHint: Onaninso zomwe mwasankha musanagawane. Palibe ulalo wagulu womwe umapangidwa.
sharing.linuxHint: Linux imatsegula pulogalamu yanu ya imelo ndi cholumikizira. Palibe chomwe chimatumizidwa zokha.

instructions.textDefault: Ndinu Novera. Yankhani momveka bwino, molondola komanso mwachidule m'chinenero cha wogwiritsa ntchito. Tsatirani zopinga zawo, tsimikizirani mfundo zazikulu ngati zingatheke ndipo tchulani kusatsimikizika. Osapanga magwero, zotsatira kapena zochita zomalizidwa.
instructions.imageDefault: Tsatirani mutu womwe mwafunsidwa, kalembedwe ndi mafelemu. Gwiritsani ntchito mawonekedwe omveka bwino, kuyatsa kogwirizana komanso tsatanetsatane wabwino. Sungani zidziwitso; pewani kupotoza ndi zinthu zosafunikira. Onjezani mawu pokhapokha mutafunsidwa.
instructions.videoDefault: Tsatirani mutu womwe mwafunsidwa, kalembedwe ndi nthawi. Sungani zinthu, zinthu ndi kuyatsa mosasinthasintha pamafelemu. Gwiritsani ntchito zoyenda zosalala komanso zoyendetsedwa ndi kamera. Pewani kutembenuka, kupotoza ndi mawu osafunsidwa.
